title: Coasting to checkout with flexible financing
summary: Making smart, well-informed decisions is the key to financial freedom. We hope these great tips will enhance your shopping experiences.
body_markdown:
Opportunity


Delivering premium bikes engineered for performance, comfort and adventure,[Ari Bikes](https://aribikes.com/) creates exceptional experiences, one rider at a time. With a focus on helping riders find the custom fit for the way they ride, the brand has built a reputation around quality products and a thoughtful customer experience.


As with many high-ticket purchases, even motivated buyers can hesitate when faced with a larger upfront cost at checkout. For Ari Bikes, that created an opportunity to make premium bikes more attainable without compromising the customer experience.


The brand needed to add payment flexibility in the purchase journey to strengthen buyer confidence and create a clearer path to conversion for customers considering a meaningful investment in their next ride.


The Bread Financial impact


Ari Bikes has scrapped the one-size-fits-all approach, not just for bikes, but for checkout, too. By integrating[Bread Pay](https://www.breadfinancial.com/en/pay-over-time.html) into the customer journey, they offer customers more ways to pay, creating a personalized purchasing experience that meets riders where they are.


By providing a clear, flexible way to pay over time, Ari Bikes helps customers understand their purchasing power at a critical decision point. This allows more customers to get the bike and gear they want, with a payment that fits their budget.


Since launch, the partnership has helped drive:


- **47%**


higher conversion among customers engaging with financing*


- **19%**


increase in average order value on financed purchases*


- **18%**


reduction in checkout abandonment*


“Bread Pay has been a fantastic partner for Ari Bikes," **Ben Wright**


, director of e-commerce of Ari Bikes, said. "Their financing solution fit seamlessly into our customer journey and instantly made our bikes more accessible. Since launch, we’ve seen higher conversion rates, stronger customer confidence and a noticeable lift in AOV on financed orders. Bread Pay has genuinely helped us remove barriers and get more riders on the bikes they love.”


*Bread Pay has genuinely helped us remove barriers and get more riders on the bikes they love.”*


Ben Wright - Director of E-Commerce, Ari Bikes
